title: StreamDuo: A Live Commentator and a Research Agent for Unseen Games

summary: Streaming video LLMs can now commentate live gameplay, but they are trained and tested on the same games. We study cross-game streaming commentary, in which a model trained on one game commentates games it has never seen, and find that current commentators transfer their timing but not their knowledge of the game world.
takeaways: We study cross-game streaming commentary, in which a model trained on one game commentates games it has never seen, and find that current commentators transfer their timing but not their knowledge of the game world.
We propose StreamDuo, which pairs a trainable commentator with a frozen research agent that reads the wiki of the game being played.
When the commentator sees something it cannot name, it sends the current frames, and the research agent returns a few wiki entries two seconds later while the stream continues.
